title: Tarantino's first, or last
what_we_know: The post puts Tarantino's in the 1970s, managed and then bought, before the Tahoe Inn and the Timber Cove. The obituary (plate 37) puts the purchase after she retired from managing the Tahoe Inn and Timber Cove. A 1972 press print (plate 31) has the couple in "their new restaurant," unnamed. Her Martinez obituary (1986) also puts Tarantino's last: Timber Cove was "the latter" of the dining rooms she managed, and "prior to her illness, she operated Angie's Tarentino's."
what_we_dont: The order, and which restaurant the 1972 print means.
what_might_answer_it: Business licenses and directories for South Lake Tahoe, 1970 to 1986; the obituary the post cites for Joe Tarantino's.
evidence_needed: A dated record of the Alexanders' purchase of Tarantino's.
